title: Skin and nail fungus test
what: A small scraping is taken from the skin or a nail. A microscope and a culture show if there is a fungus.
why: For flaking, itching, or patches on the skin, or for thick or yellow nails, before treatment starts.
duration: the scraping takes 5 to 10 minutes; microscope results usually in 1 to 3 days, the culture in 2 to 4 weeks
tell_doctor: If you put antifungal products on your skin or nails
If your nails have polish or medicated polish

prepare.title: Treatment
prepare.text: The test is usually done before treatment or after a break. Your doctor will tell you how long the break is. Do not stop on your own.

prepare.title: Nails
prepare.text: For a few days before, do not cut or file the affected nails. Remove nail polish.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: On the test day, do not put creams on the skin or wash the area with soap.

steps: The doctor looks at your skin or nails
Flakes of skin or bits of nail are gently scraped off with a small blade
The sample is collected on a glass slide or in a tube
It is sent to the lab
feel: Usually painless. Only the top dead layer is taken
Sometimes a little unpleasant at the edge of the nail
after: You can go back to your usual day right away
Microscope results usually come in 1 to 3 days
The culture takes 2 to 4 weeks. It shows which fungus it is

faq.q: Why not use ointment before the test?
faq.a: It can hide the fungus, and the test may come back with nothing found.

faq.q: Do I need the test if the fungus is obvious?
faq.a: Yes. Changes that look like fungus can come from other conditions. Fungus treatment is long, so it is confirmed first.

reminders.text: Fungus test tomorrow. Do not cut the affected nails, remove nail polish, and do not put cream on the skin.
